_encoding: u64 fields are JSON strings; numbers above 2^53 lose precision through JSON.parse. init-spot-markets.ts converts via BN(string).

_fields.optimal_borrow_rate: borrow APR at the kink, 1e6 = 100% (e.g. 100000 = 10% APR)
_fields.min_borrow_rate: floor APR, u8 in 0.5% units (2 = 1%); null = leave program default
_fields.imf_factor: imf margin scaling with position size, 1e6
_fields.scale_initial_asset_weight_start: deposits TVL (USD 1e6) above which initial asset weight starts scaling down; 0 = never
_fields.withdraw_guard_threshold: token amount (mint decimals) below which withdraw guards do not bind
_fields.order_tick_size: spot order price tick, PRICE_PRECISION 1e6; init-only, not synced on existing markets
_fields.order_step_size: spot order size step, mint decimals; init-only, not synced on existing markets
_fields.if_total_factor: share of borrow interest routed to the insurance fund, 1e6 (onchain field: insurance_fund.if_fee_factor; tuned post-init via spot-market set-fee-factors)
_fields.max_token_deposits: deposit cap, token amount in mint decimals; 0 = uncapped
_fields.max_token_borrows_fraction: borrow cap as fraction of max_token_deposits, 1e4 = 100%; 0 = uncapped
_fields.deposit_cap_usd: USD intent for max_token_deposits, whole dollars; when non-null the token cap is re-derived at the live oracle price on sync (2% tolerance); null = use max_token_deposits as-is
_fields.withdraw_guard_usd: USD intent for withdraw_guard_threshold, same semantics as deposit_cap_usd

_new_collateral_2026_08_29.assets: wBTC (index 2) and wETH (index 3), pending init. JLP and jitoSOL are deferred: neither has a 1-minute price series for the adverse-window measurement, and both are LST/pool-token assets that must pass the separate liquidation-executability gate before they can be collateral.
_new_collateral_2026_08_29.caps: Deposit caps are set well below the formula output (quote IF vault / tail: $6.0M wBTC, $4.5M wETH). The formula sizes each asset against the full insurance fund, i.e. single-market stress; SOL's live cap already consumes the vault at its own tail, so correlated capacity is uncovered. Launch caps of $1.0M and $750k sit ~20x above the seeded deposits and ~6x below the formula. Raising a cap later is one instruction with no user impact.
_new_collateral_2026_08_29.weights: Asset weights are 7500/8500, one notch below the pre-hack Drift values and live SOL (8000/9000). Raising a weight later is free; lowering one derates existing depositors' collateral, so the cheap direction to be wrong in is low.
_new_collateral_2026_08_29.tails: Measured p99.99 worst forward drop over a 5-minute liquidator clear window, Binance 1m klines 2024-01 through 2026-06: BTC 2.278% (used 3%), ETH 3.517% (used 4%). Rounding is up to the next whole percent, the rule that reproduces the shipped SOL params (measured 4.01%, used 5%). Regenerated from scratch on 2026-08-29; the risk repo's SOL reproduction gate passed and the outputs were byte-identical to the committed results.
_new_collateral_2026_08_29.oracles: wBTC uses Pyth Lazer feed 1 and wETH feed 2, the same oracle accounts the BTC and ETH perp markets already use. Both are live and cranked, so no new oracle infrastructure is needed.
open: Mint choice is inherited from the pre-hack Drift row (Wormhole wBTC). Treasury also holds cbBTC, zBTC and LBTC; custody-backed and bridge-backed representations are different risk classes and the choice is a council decision, not a parameter default.

The measured tail is for native BTC/ETH on a centralised venue. It does not model bridge failure (not tail-shaped) or thin on-chain liquidity for the wrapped asset; the inherited imf_factor partially prices the latter.
Other base params (liability weights, rate curve, imf_factor, liquidation fees, tick/step) are the pre-hack Drift values, each already at or stricter than the live SOL equivalent.
